-,uoQ4#c5(t;ov~%gjd{.text: This sprite is in place so you the project runs a little faster on slower computers. The "Blank/Help" has almost no scripts in it because Scratch 3.0 has something weird: When the project loads, the project editor will also load! This means that if the first sprite is the "Player" sprite, the project would be slower because it also has to render the 1000+ blocks that are in that sprite. The "Blank/Help" is here so the project would not slow down because of there being a lot of blocks in the loaded sprite.
